a sound at the place catches the pet off guard and it follows it
the pet waits for something (a turn, a door, a light, food) and the waiting becomes the scene
the weather or light changes while the pet is there
the pet misreads or mishears something about the place and is gently corrected
a child, a worker or a vendor does something small that the pet copies or answers
the pet gets turned around or takes a wrong turn and finds its way using what the place offers
the pet notices one small detail everyone else walks past
a smell arrives before the thing itself does
the pet tries to do it the way locals seem to, and only half manages
the pet is too early or too late for something and makes the best of it
the pet compares the place to how it imagined it before arriving
the pet shares a bench, table or queue with a stranger and they exchange one sentence
the pet keeps count of something there (steps, boats, bells, bites) and loses count
the pet is asked a question by a passer-by and has to think about the answer
the pet's first attempt at something (ordering, crossing, climbing, tasting) goes slightly wrong, the second goes right
the pet stays still long enough for the place to change around it
the pet says goodbye to something at the place before moving on
the pet discovers it has been doing something the hard way
a crowd moves one way and the pet goes the other for a moment
the pet finds the place quieter, louder, bigger or smaller than expected, and reacts with its body
